serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: SignifiVISION is a cloud-based software-as-a-service platform used to manage and support Signifi unattended self-service kiosk and locker solutions. The offering provides centralized administration, monitoring, configuration, operational support, and related service functionality for deployed environments.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Cloud-based software platform for centralized management, monitoring, configuration, and support of Signifi self-service solutions.
